capability: Ship the cut whose parts join; hold back the rest
title: Every join must hold.

hook.picture: Close on the whale pulling a short, smooth line longer, like taffy. The middle thins.
hook.words: Just make it a bit longer.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: We made it longer and it stopped making sense.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: course lead reviewing a stretched explainer

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: the long line is a row of pieces, each made on its own, with ends at different heights. Three-times device: three more pieces drop in, every 2 beats, then 1, then half, and each misses its neighbour.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each new piece was made alone.

stakes.body: A long cut that does not hang together costs a class session and the learners' trust in every film after it.

solution_hint: Ship only the cut where parts join.

metaphor.body: A film is a line made of pieces. Where two pieces meet is a join that must line up, and only a line whose joins all match goes out to the pod.

steps.picture: The whale lays two cuts side by side, a short line and a long one, and walks each join with a small ring.
steps.words: Ship only the cut where parts join.

steps.picture: On the short line every join turns teal; on the long line two joins glow terracotta.
steps.sound: Chord on teal, beat on terracotta

steps.picture: A gate at the shore lets the short line through to the pod and stays closed for the long one, which is set aside on the bank, not thrown away.
steps.words: Not ready? It waits. Nothing is forced.

steps.picture: The teal joins get their name; the set-aside line keeps its stills pinned beside it.
steps.words: Checks live where parts meet: the seams.

real_case.claim: Experiment E0 in ceti-explainer, round one: the 2-minute lecture committed; the 5-minute single-file cut did not glue, and its stills atlas is the conserved record.

honest_limit.picture: Push in on the shipped short line: every join is teal, yet the pod at the end tilts, puzzled.
honest_limit.words: It fits. Did anyone learn it?

not_this.body: Fits together is not the same as taught.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing returns. The whale starts to stretch the line, then stops at the length where every join is still teal; the pod receives it and answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: The stretch that tore the line in bar 2 now stops before the tear, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Ship the shorter cut that holds together.

score_self.reason: Felt pain is common for course leads, and the hold-back is honest. Weak spot: "join" versus "seam" may blur, and the four-stop CASE is abstract without its stage names on screen.
